title: CBSE Board 12th Supplementary Date Sheet 2026
vacancyDetails: Class 12 Supplementary / Compartment exam for all subjects on a single day as per revised date sheet
qualification: Students eligible for CBSE Class 12 Supplementary Exam 2026
applicationFee: As applicable via school for compartment exam
documentsRequired: Admit card from school / CBSE; school ID / photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.cbse.gov.in
2. Download Supplementary Date Sheet Class XII PDF
3. Note exam date 28 July 2026 and subject timings
4. Collect admit card from school when issued
5. Appear at allotted centre
shortDescription: CBSE Class 12 Supplementary Date Sheet 2026 released – all subjects on 28 July 2026 (Tuesday). Download PDF from cbse.gov.in.
content:
CBSE has released the Senior Secondary Supplementary Examination 2026 Date Sheet.

All subjects will be conducted on Tuesday, 28 July 2026 (revised from earlier 15 July schedule in some reports).

Timings

  • Most subjects: 10:30 AM – 1:30 PM
  • Selected 2-hour papers: 10:30 AM – 12:30 PM

Official PDF: Supplementary_Datesheet_XII on cbse.gov.in. Students should collect admit cards from their schools.
